title: New run
noVersions: No dataset versions are available yet. Ask an admin to add one on the "Datasets" page.

copied.title: Collection copied
copied.summary_one: New collection "{{name}}" created with {{count}} run carried over. These runs do not match the new spec and stay in the original collection:
copied.summary_other: New collection "{{name}}" created with {{count}} runs carried over. These runs do not match the new spec and stay in the original collection:

copy.title: Copy collection and change its spec
copy.intro: The fixed configuration is filled in from the original collection. Use the form below to change fixed values and choose the dimensions that may vary; runs that match the new spec are carried into the copy.
copy.name: New collection name
copy.baseRun: Fill configuration from an existing run (optional, still editable afterwards)
copy.baseFixed: Fixed configuration of the original collection

fromCollection: New run from collection <link>{{name}}</link>: the fixed dimensions ({{dimensions}}) are filled in from the collection and locked; choose only the variable dimensions, tasks and concurrency. The run joins the collection when submitted; a configuration that does not match the collection is pointed out at "Check configuration".
fromRun: Modifying run <link>{{id}}</link>: the form is filled with the values the original run actually used (team defaults and model revision are pinned). Differences from the original run are recorded on submit.

plan.title: Experiment plan
plan.description: A plan is a saved set of configuration, visible to the team. Choosing one fills the form from it; the submission still references the plan, fields you changed are recorded as "This submission" and the rest as "Experiment plan".
plan.saveAs: Save the current form as a plan

collection.fromForm: Create a collection from the current form
collection.fromFormHint: Fixed dimensions take the form's current values; you can then create runs from the collection

basic.title: Basics
basic.noSubmittableVersion: No version of this dataset has submittable tasks. Ask an admin to complete the first preparation.
basic.agentMode: Model experiment: a Harness drives the chosen model through the tasks
basic.oracleMode: Oracle test mode: runs the tasks' own reference solutions, calls no model, not part of model comparisons
basic.clientRequestIdHint: Lets you find this run by this ID later

model.title: Model and Harness
model.description: Model configurations and Harnesses are maintained by admins; here you can only choose.
model.noModels: No enabled model configurations yet. Ask an admin to add one under "Admin → Models".
model.pinned: Pinned to revision {{pinned}} used by the original run (current is revision {{current}}).
model.noHarness: No Harness version can call this model's protocol.

attachments.title: Attachments (in load order)
attachments.intro: Each trial copies and installs these attachments in order in its own container before the Agent starts. Members publish attachments on the<link>Attachments page</link>.

scale.title: Scale and resources
scale.description: Leave blank to inherit: repetitions, concurrency and the total time limit come from team defaults; resources and timeouts come from the task authors. Values over the team limits are rejected, not silently lowered.
scale.authorTimeoutHint: Leave blank to use each task author's setting
scale.resourceHint: Sum over all containers in the trial; leave blank for the author's setting. Can only be raised; the extra goes to the main environment

params.title: Author parameters
params.description: Parameters declared by the task authors. A secret parameter can only take a team credential, not a literal value; credentials are maintained by admins and only their names are shown here.

submit.separateHint: A modified run is submitted on its own

draft.description: Runs in a batch are accepted together: if any one cannot be submitted, the whole batch is not accepted and no token quota is used. Once accepted, each runs on its own.
draft.name: Batch name

resolution.blocked: The configuration has blockers and cannot be submitted
resolution.validUntil: The result is valid until {{time}} and reserves no capacity or quota; the server checks again on submit and asks for a new check if the configuration has changed meanwhile.
resolution.baselineItem: {{field}} = {{value}} (below the author for {{lower}} tasks, above for {{higher}})
resolution.preparation_one: {{count}} task has no local cache; it is restored automatically before the run starts, no admin action needed.
resolution.preparation_other: {{count}} tasks have no local cache; they are restored automatically before the run starts, no admin action needed.
resolution.pending: The outcome of the last submission is unknown (network or server error). Submitting again reuses the same idempotency key and will not create the run twice.
